Game Overview

Noob vs Hacker is a monster title where navigate a treacherous desert as the noob in a thrilling race against a crafty hacker. Solve mind-bending puzzles, dodge monsters, and employ the crucial double jump to progress. Experience nostalgic pixel art and intuitive controls in this charming, fast-paced adventure where strategy and speed are your greatest allies.
